Camila — a few internal clarifications for the runbook:
- For hosted customers like Lark, we can scrub the conversation from runtime logs and our analytics index quickly; those operations also redact KV cache references and any cached embeddings referencing the thread.
- The audit index removal will remove searchable pointers but we keep an internal tombstone record (non-PHI) for compliance tracking — the tombstone contains a hashed reference only.
- Backups: we do not modify historical immutable backups unless Legal signs off for assisted prune. If Lark needs those removed from backups, we should request a retention exception and route to infra; that path requires GC signoff and may take up to 14 days.
- Evidence: we can provide a signed deletion attestation (PDF) and a short runbook excerpt listing the operations performed.

I'll standby to approve the expunge job once Camila confirms receipt of ID + signed auth. If the customer insists on backup removal, I'll coordinate legal.
